fields.label: Type d'étude
fields.quote: In our experiments we will ensemble the two most zero-shot effective LLMs and the BERT-based method we use as a comparative baseline.

fields.label: Données
fields.value: 39 sujets de revue et plus de 50 000 documents candidats.
fields.quote: The Seed Collection dataset consists of 39 review topics and over 50,000 candidate documents [52].6
fields.note: chunk_id corrigé : le LLM citait 'arxiv-2401-06320_p6_c3', la citation est dans arxiv-2401-06320_p6_c2

fields.label: Modèles
fields.value: Modèles évalués : Alpaca-7b-ins, Guanaco-7b-ins, Falcon-7b-ins, LlaMa2-7b-ins, LlaMa2-13b-ins.
fields.quote: Note that for consistency of the paper, we name all instruction-tuned models with -ins; The original names are: Alpaca-7b-ins: alpaca; Guanaco-7b-ins: guanaco-7b; Falcon-7b-ins: falcon-7b-instruct; LlaMa2-7b-ins: LlaMa2-7b-chat; LlaMa2-13b-ins: LlaMa2-13b-chat;

fields.label: Résultats
fields.value: 70% des sujets ont atteint un rappel parfait, contre seulement 50% avec l'autre méthode de calibration.
fields.quote: 70% of topics achieved perfect recall, compared to only 50% using the other calibration method.
